status: locally frozen before new validation data

profile.primary: mean across-network squared response-range width, averaged across three fixed targets; both versus neither
profile.threshold: MAP objective <= best of five starts + 2; numerical feasible ranges, not confidence intervals
profile.search: SLSQP two starts per sign and target; 160 iterations; exact prior-derived coordinate bounds
secondary: noise-dose effects on widths and MSE
profile.failure: retain all networks, all fits and optimizer flags; record feasible extrema; report numerical-search limits
profile.repeats: one prespecified truth/noise pair per network; no outcomes used to select cases

method.primary: prior_cv versus local mean raw response MSE
method.candidate: greedy held-out prior-predictive risk of a joint covariance surrogate, including analytic observation-noise contribution
method.baseline_candidate: same joint covariance surrogate using internal Gaussian posterior variance
method.truth_access: design uses public prior simulations only; all 5 measurement slots count; held-out response used only for evaluation

fitting.starts_definition: zero, two .25 prior-SD draws, two full prior-SD draws

inference.primary_ci: 95 percent per separately specified scientific question
